title: Focus Cleanup + Competitor Board
summary: YTIntel is much less overwhelming: Analyse is now the default start, the useful competitor tracker gets its own focused screen, and duplicated or broken navigation has been removed for now.
discord_changes: Kept the useful competitor Watchtower + movement feature and gave it a dedicated Competitors screen.
Removed Smart Start and Research Sprint from the visible product for now so Analyse stays the core workflow.
Removed Quick switch, Jump to, What's New and Evidence-first from the top bar to cut duplicated UI noise.
changes: Repurposed the old Smart Start route into a dedicated Competitors screen without exposing Smart Start itself.
Kept the tracked-competitor list, scan controls, recent competitor videos and movement comparison intact.
Reworded the competitor surface around 3–10 direct competitors, recent uploads, standout videos and changes between scans.
Made Analyse the default starting screen when opening the app.
Removed Research Sprint from navigation and hid the broken Sprint surface for now.
Removed Quick switch and Jump to, including their duplicate command-palette surfaces.
Removed the broken What's New button and the Evidence-first status chip from the header.
Added v0.29.4 to the in-app Updates log and bumped the PWA shell cache.
why_it_matters: The product should feel obvious the moment it opens. Analyse handles the core video-understanding job, Competitors keeps the genuinely useful competitive-pressure workflow, and everything that duplicated those paths or added noise is out of the way for now.
